d: Our Recruiting team at is currently looking for a Recruiter to support our Sales, Service & Delivery Function. The ideal candidate has already gained experience recruiting for those sectors and is committed to finding the very best talent.

When you’re doing something nobody has ever done before, the old ways can frequently come up short. At Tesla, you’ll get the opportunity to be creative, to try, to fail, to learn and to succeed. You will have an appetite for risk, for taking that big bet, because that’s how we leap ahead together.
q: Previous 360 recruiting experience in an agency and/or corporate environment
A demonstrated track record of excellence in sourcing, assessing and hiring talent in volume
Proven relationship management experience with hiring teams and business partners, taking lead on assessing talent needs and setting hiring plans
Digitally savvy – ability to adopt and adapt quickly to new technology and systems
Experience working in an agile, fast-paced environment where things change very quickly
The ability to adapt to constantly changing/fluctuating targets and business needs
Skills in offer negotiation, awareness of pertinent employment legislation and employment market trends
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
